read.en: Corning fell 1.1% on Oct 27 to $126.30, trading between $121.76 and $128.48 on about twice average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($127.3), 10-day ($131.3), 30-day ($147.5) and 100-day ($162.7) averages and the rising 200-day ($155.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($137.65), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 康宁 10月27日下跌 1.1%，收于 $126.30，盘中区间 $121.76–128.48，成交量约为平均水平的 2 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$127.3）、10 日（$131.3）、30 日（$147.5）和 100 日均线（$162.7）以及上行的 200 日均线（$155.1）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$137.65），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The $128.5 high stalled again and the close slipped back under $126.7–127.6 (Mar 30 and Oct 20 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $126.7–127.6, then $128.5–128.6 (Oct 26–27 highs) and $131.3–132.8 (10-day, Oct 15–16 lows). Support is $121.8–122.8, then $120 (Mar 9 low) and $114.5 (Jul 28 low). A close below $121.8 would open $114.5–120; above $128.6, $131–133.
